instruction: Please turn off the background cone visualization in VLC's interface settings so it doesn't appear when no media is playing.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the VLC background cone icon (qt-bgcone=0). The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_bgcone function which reads the VLC config file and verifies that qt-bgcone is set to 0 (disabled). The original task changed max volume to 200%, this variation changes the background cone visibility setting to 0.
